lines.text: Up 275% on the year: Palkia (Diamond and Pearl) 11/130 went from $9.09 on Oct 23, 2025 to $34.07 on Oct 25, and is flat over 7 days, up 27% over 30 days and up 41% over 90 days. That beats its set over 30 days: up 27% against a +1.7% median for 31 Diamond and Pearl items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.5% for 9932 priced items across the market. It is level with its highest price on file, first reached on Oct 18, with records back to Feb 8, 2024.
Plasma Storm, about 30 days: 8 of 16 priced cards up 10% or more, 1 down 10% or more. Start prices Sep 26, end Oct 25, TCGplayer market.
